infoData.description:
I'm glad you're here.

I'm a Product Design Lead focused on transforming complex challenges into elegant solutions. I have a proven track record in driving user engagement and business growth across diverse industries, including finance, cybersecurity, advertising and online safety.

I'm an expert in user-centered design and information architecture, optimizing workflows for startups, mid-sized, and large organizations.

A collaborative and organized team player, I'm known for building consensus and driving projects efficiently. I prioritize clear, intuitive, and user-friendly designs that align with business goals.
